scope: Static checked-in configuration, actual Vitest/Playwright discovery, and a sparse missing-dependency preflight reproduction. No application changes, test execution, package installation, or GitHub run.

ciPrerequisiteGap.job:
name: Remediation preservation (source + browser + export)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm install --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Install local-fixture browser
        run: npx playwright install chromium
      - name: Source, generated module, rendered fidelity and export regressions
        run: npm run verify:remediation
      - name: Retain remediation validation evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: remediation-validation
          path: test-results/remediation-validation/
          if-no-files-found: warn
ciPrerequisiteGap.preflightError: A required validation input is missing
